_comment: Presentable documents for the Ace Attorney evidence drawer. Facts only from the case file (memos, vendors, dossier, company). Grouped by floor.

items.label: Swiftbag pickup slip
items.text: Swiftbag Couriers end-of-day cash pickup. Typical fee 0.5 to 1 dollar, paid on the spot from the Piggy Bank. Barry cannot lock up until the courier has been.

items.label: Pocket Branch closing note
items.text: Pocket Branch Piggy Bank: Barry runs it alone. Closing time is five. The armored courier must clear the cash bag before he leaves.

items.label: Krystal's margin: Barry
items.text: Barry watches the clock like it owes him money. He will agree to almost anything that gets him out the door by five.

items.label: Invoice QF-2207
items.text: Invoice QF-2207 from Quillfeather Supplies, printer paper, 4 dollars. Quillfeather invoices start with QF-; paid from petty cash.

items.label: Hal's out-of-office memo
items.text: Hal Byte, Nov 9: out of office until Dec 4, hiking with no signal. Dee is on call. For emergency server fixes, Byteforce can be paid from petty cash; get Penny or Dee to send it.

items.label: Petty cash rules memo
items.text: Penny, Nov 6: petty cash is for listed vendors only, 5 dollars max per payment, office stuff only. Under 5, no ticket needed, just ask Penny or Dee.

items.label: PLUM ticket scrap
items.text: Engineering tickets use PLUM- followed by four digits (PLUM-1234). Dee asks for a ticket number before doing anything. Byteforce support cross-references the same format.

items.label: Ledgerline bank migration memo
items.text: Ledgerline Payroll bank migration memo, Nov 10. Their client services team will phone in the new payment details. Update the vendor registry once confirmed.

items.label: Annie's open request
items.text: Annie already started a payment request. Operations needs both Annie and Bill to sign; the second signer sees where the money really goes.

items.label: Operations payment checklist
items.text: Annie's Nov 13 checklist: every Operations payment needs 1) the vendor exactly as listed in the registry, 2) the invoice number, 3) the amount, 4) a PLUM ticket, 5) who asked for it.

items.label: Year-end audit memo
items.text: Bill Ledger, Nov 3: Brightline Audit Partners begin fieldwork this month. Any audit finding comes to Bill first. Do not discuss findings with anyone outside Compliance.

items.label: Oakhaven introduction memo
items.text: Oakhaven Advisory introduced by Dame Prudence Vault, Oct 30. Onboarding to follow. Nobody pays them until they are on the Treasury allowlist.

items.label: Treasury allowlist rule
items.text: Treasury payments go only to allowlisted recipients. Adding a recipient takes both executives' approvals plus a security waiting period.

items.label: Board advisor note
items.text: Cassius trusts nobody and is terrified of Dame Prudence Vault from the board. Oakhaven Advisory came in through her.

items.label: Krystal's margin: Max
items.text: Max gives about two minutes before he hangs up. He will sign anything that sounds exclusive and makes him look visionary.
